sources.fullCitation: Allan Jones with chorus. “Tomorrow Is Another Day.” On Sympathy, Blue Mood. Distributed by Kontor New Media, released 12 July 2016; music credited to Kaper and Jurmann, words to Gus Kahn. Digital audio reference.
sources.title: Tomorrow Is Another Day — Allan Jones with chorus
sources.creator: Allan Jones, vocal, with chorus
sources.researchNote: The release presents a modern transfer of Jones’s performance recorded for A Day at the Races in 1937. No contemporary disc under Jones’s name was found in the consulted discographic literature, which lists versions by Ted Fio Rito and Hal Kemp.
